F1_test_coverage.evidence: New file tests/unit/test_gpu_engine_jax_failure.py adds 3 parameterized subprocess tests (RuntimeError, AttributeError, ImportError). Each test verifies (a) module import succeeds, (b) _require_jax() raises RuntimeError with __cause__ set, (c) GPUBacktestEngine instantiation raises RuntimeError with __cause__ set. Uses subprocess because JAX is installed in the parent process and cached in sys.modules. All 3 tests pass.

F2_exception_chain.evidence: _jax_import_error now stores the exception object (gpu_engine.py:67: '_jax_import_error = _jax_err'), not its str(). _require_jax() uses 'raise RuntimeError(...) from _jax_import_error' (gpu_engine.py:81) to preserve __cause__. Test asserts 'e.__cause__ is not None' and the cause message contains the original error.
F2_exception_chain.verified_in_review: Manually simulated: with `_jax_import_error = RuntimeError('X')`, raising RuntimeError from it sets __cause__ correctly. Tests confirm runtime chain preservation.

F3_logger_warning.evidence: logger.warning() added in the except block (gpu_engine.py:68-71) with type name and message: 'JAX unavailable in gpu_engine (%s: %s); GPUBacktestEngine will raise RuntimeError on use.' Uses the existing module logger (gpu_engine.py:32).
F3_logger_warning.verified_in_review: Manually triggered: subprocess with fake __import__ that raises RuntimeError produces 'WARNING:gpu_fuzzy_trader.backtest.gpu_engine:JAX unavailable in gpu_engine (RuntimeError: ...)' on stderr.

_maybe_jit.correctness: Returns jit(fn) when jit is available, else returns fn unchanged. When applied as @_maybe_jit, behaves identically to @jit on a working install. Verified directly: with jit=None, decorator(f) is f; with jit=jax.jit, decorator(f) is jit(f).
_maybe_jit.necessity: Module-level @jit decorators crash at import time when jit=None. Without this wrapper, AC-5 (import does not crash) cannot be met.

_maybe_partial_jit.correctness: Returns partial(jit, **kwargs) when jit is available (identical to @partial(jit, static_argnums=...)), else returns a passthrough lambda. Used by _jax_simulate_equity_batch with static_argnums=(4,5,6,7,8,9,10). Verified: with jit=None, returns same function unchanged.

new_wrappers_assessment.closure_correctness: Both wrappers use the module-level jit variable (not a captured parameter), so they correctly track the post-import value. No stale-closure bug.

potential_issues_considered.jax_compat_attribute_error: Noted that backtest/jax_compat.py _GPU_ENGINE_ERRORS = (ImportError, RuntimeError, OSError) does NOT include AttributeError. However, this is out of scope for task-3: gpu_engine.py itself now catches Exception, so AttributeError is handled at the module level. If task-1 had been supposed to add AttributeError to jax_compat.py, that change appears to be missing from main, but is not introduced or required by task-3.
potential_issues_considered.test_env_var: test_gpu_engine_jax_failure.py sets env={'NO_JAX_RECURSIVE_IMPORT': '1', ...}. NO_JAX_RECURSIVE_IMPORT does not appear to be read by any code in the project. Harmless no-op; minor cleanliness nit but not a blocker.
potential_issues_considered.wrapper_naming: _maybe_jit and _maybe_partial_jit are underscored (private), minimal, and only used in this file. No public API impact.
potential_issues_considered.module_import_order: from functools import partial is on line 34, after logging setup. Pre-existing style; not a task-3 regression.

positive_notes: All 3 previous code review findings are properly and minimally addressed.
The _maybe_jit / _maybe_partial_jit wrappers are necessary, minimal, and equivalent in behavior to the originals when JAX is available.
Test coverage now includes 3 distinct failure modes (RuntimeError, AttributeError, ImportError), each verifying the full chain: import, _require_jax(), and GPUBacktestEngine instantiation.
Exception chain (F2) is preserved end-to-end (test asserts e.__cause__ is not None).
Logger warning (F3) uses the existing module logger and is informative.
Guard placement in __init__() is correct: first executable statement, before any jax.* access (including self._backend = jax.default_backend() on line 622).
All 58 existing tests pass — no regression in the working path.
The defensive except Exception is well-scoped: it only catches at module-import time, so it does not mask runtime JAX errors inside working backtest code.
summary: All 6 acceptance criteria fully satisfied. All 3 previous code review findings (F1 test coverage, F2 exception chain, F3 logger warning) are properly addressed. The new _maybe_jit and _maybe_partial_jit wrappers are necessary, minimal, and correct — they preserve original behavior when JAX is available and allow safe module import when JAX is broken. No new issues introduced. Approving.
